mapper.select: select task_id, user_id, text, start, end, progress, type, status, owner, description, parent_id, open, sort_order, create_time, update_time from gantt_task where user_id = #{userId} order by parent_id, sort_order
select task_id, user_id, text, start, end, progress, type, status, owner, description, parent_id, open, sort_order, create_time, update_time from gantt_task where task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.insert: insert into gantt_task (user_id, text, start, end, progress, type, status, owner, description, parent_id, open, sort_order, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{text}, #{start}, #{end}, #{progress}, #{type}, #{status}, #{owner}, #{description}, #{parentId}, #{open}, #{sortOrder}, #{createTime})
mapper.update:
update gantt_task
text = #{text},
start = #{start},
end = #{end},
progress = #{progress},
type = #{type},
status = #{status},
owner = #{owner},
description = #{description},
parent_id = #{parentId},
open = #{open},
sort_order = #{sortOrder},
update_time = #{updateTime},
